BiblicalUsage: Paul asks for the opening of his mouth, that utterance may be given him to make known the mystery of the gospel. The word is the opening itself, here the opening of the lips to speak boldly.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for an opening mouth carries no doctrine of its own; its plea is Paul's, that he might speak the gospel boldly as he ought.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
